display_name: 源模拟信道与估计信道的微扰响应对照
description: 在合法源 IQ 上比较已固定 DURA 估计信道与匹配模拟器信道对相同合成扰动的响应，无 F、TX 标签或目标读取。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU4, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4, FP32 TF32 off, batch 32

data.representation: source received/clean IQ and simulator kernel, widely-linear coefficients, variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 frozen source pilot physical IDs, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views; read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only privileged simulator oracle, IQ NMSE not identity accuracy or performance upper bound

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura source-only provenance and epoch19 matching source action cache
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA, no F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed original DURA; no target score selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU4: at least 8192 MiB free, fewer than 3 total compute apps and at most one this-task worker; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop for source contract mismatch, nonfinite action or output, real-checkpoint smoke failure, resource collision or any F/TX/V/target read; preserve other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json source-only 14 cells × 4 perturbation directions, true versus estimated action

metric_names: source perturbation action normalized squared difference

rows.method: Compare DURA-estimated and source simulator actions on identical four 1%-RMS synthetic perturbations
rows.purpose: Quantify the proxy mismatch for possible future source response regularization
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.budget_ref: 672 source observations, batch32, no training; first batch real-checkpoint smoke

notes: True simulator action is privileged source-only evidence, unavailable at target inference; no F, TX labels, V, target or model updates.
The 672 pilot examples were explored previously and DURA may have seen source records; comparisons are not TX identity performance, real satellite evidence, or a universal bound.
All models and running experiments remain unchanged; this measurement cannot guarantee improved identification.
